fill_reason.pin_bound: 975 pin bits: E 528 out / W 363 in on M4 at 2 tracks over 105.84 um = 48%/33% of slots; N 84 on M5 over 25.92 = 34%; outline from measured-util resize (FLOORPLAN_MARGIN 67.3% at 23.76x95.04).

job.purpose: hard_v5 COLL q3 qslots 32-bit switch slice (NS11 ND16), 17x in q3; every output a flop Q.

pin_regs.reason: Actual RTL already registers every port at the face: qslots_output captures captured/captured_slot/sink_slot/sink_select into _p flops before any logic; dst_v/dst_d/select_fault/unavailable_fault are flop Q. Recipe-2 output stage on: io_flop_at_pins anchors only the OUTPUT launch flops at their pins (OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE), pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs give one launch flop per output pin; inputs keep their inhold pad.

structural_change: Loop verdict hcoll_v5_qso3w-qs1045-92800f413 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN: flow std 1187 um2 = util 67.3% in 23.76x95.04 (gate synth 939 under-estimated by 1.27x); area x1.22 at the same aspect -> 25.92x105.84, core 2193 um2 = 54% at the measured std; same RTL, pin faces, recipe. Plus the recipe-2 output stage (io_flop_at_pins on outputs only, pin_reg_split, keep_pin_regs, balanced pins) so dst launch meets the native 220-ps budget (qcap twin failed launch 240.4 without it).
